All dsh plugins; your data stays on your computer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"MyWork"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"AI teammates that live on your computer.

Your data stays on your computer; your phone reaches it from any network throu"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"gh an encrypted relay."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Web: one sentence under "new teammate", and MyWork makes 前沿哨兵 after nilenso's way of keeping up with"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" AI; it asks one thing, then hands over today's page (waits sped up, video)

The first version, MyWork Kit (a dsh plugin bundle: live browser, sheets and sl"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ides, IM assistant), is at tag `v0.0.1`; the desktop installers under Releases are that version too."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Most AI products are one-off chats: ask, answer, close. Real work isn't like that. The morning indus"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"try news, the Friday weekly report, the competitor prices you keep watching are **ongoing jobs**. So"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"meone has to remember the context, do it on time, hand you the result, and come back only when there"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"er the context, do it on time, hand you the result, and come back only when there's a real question."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"MyWork turns AI into **teammates**, not a chat box:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **One teammate owns one ongoing job.** 前沿哨兵 brings you one page of first-hand AI news every mornin"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"g, 论文哨兵 goes through the whole arXiv listing every weekday, and MyWork takes anything else.
- **One "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"teammate, one conversation.** It remembers your preferences; "make it shorter" changes the thing it "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"just made.
- **It works in the background and the result comes back to the conversation**, as a file"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" with checkable key numbers, verified independently by a second session.
- **It interrupts you only "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"when it must**: missing key information, a decision only you can make, a consequential action (payin"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"g, sending, deleting), or a password, code or scan.
- **Your data stays on your computer.** No accou"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"nt, and your data never goes to a cloud; the phone pairs with this computer by QR, and the relay in "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"between only passes encrypted data."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The product logic follows Rakazo (persistent AI teammates rather than disposable chats). It runs on "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh), built entirely as plugins without modifying dsh."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 1. Teammates"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Feature | What it does |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| One sentence makes one | "+" at the top left or "new teammate" at the end of the list; say what it"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" is responsible for (name, type and avatar are optional). MyWork picks the closest practitioner's wa"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"y of working and rewrites it from your words into the teammate's job, rules, the one thing it asks y"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ou first, and what it will do unasked. |
| Whose way of working | Daily papers (Su Jianlin), knowled"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ge base (Karpathy's LLM Wiki), experiments (Karpathy's autoresearch), code research (Simon Willison)"},{"id":"p15s6","text":", paper writing (Neel Nanda), evals (Hamel Husain, Shreya Shankar), keeping up with AI (Atharva Rayk"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ar of nilenso), chief of staff (Garry Tan's GBrain), engineering health (Will Larson). They are refe"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"rences, not templates, in `packages/tasks/playbooks/`. |
| First day | The new teammate says hello, "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"what it does and whose way it follows; a kickoff card asks you one thing (you can drop files in). On"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ce you answer it writes its rules into its own `AGENTS.md` and lists what it will do unasked (one pa"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"ge every day at 8:30, going back to the primary source for any claim you forward…); only what you ti"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"ck counts. |
| Let MyWork create it | Tell MyWork about an ongoing job ("every Monday, look at …"). "},{"id":"p15s13","text":"It first checks whether a teammate already does it; if not, it asks whether to find the job its own "},{"id":"p15s14","text":"teammate, and on "new teammate" it creates one, which can do the first round right away. A teammate "},{"id":"p15s15","text":"card stays in the conversation and opens it; the job is that teammate's from then on. |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Data and privacy"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Everything lives in `$DSH_HOME` (`.dsh-dev-home/home` in development): teammates in `mywork/mates."},{"id":"p20s2","text":"json`, each teammate's folder in `mywork/mates/<id>/`, runs, deliveries, routines and read state in "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"`mywork/*.json`, session logs in `sessions/`.
- The API key and logins are there too; copy the direc"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"tory to move machines (it holds the key in plain text).
- The web app listens on this machine only. "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"Phone access must be switched on at the computer; the phone gateway also listens on this machine onl"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"y and is reached from outside only through the relay, accepts only the pairing token, and dsh's logi"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"n token never leaves the computer. The relay passes encrypted data only: the computer's X25519 publi"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"c key travels only after `#` on the pairing code, the relay lacks its secret key and can neither rea"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"d nor impersonate it, and only MyWork's API, signed file links and the phone's push subscription are"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" reachable through it. Push notifications go from the computer to the phone's push service encrypted"},{"id":"p20s11","text":" for that phone (Web Push, RFC 8291), signed with a key that never leaves the computer.
- The relay "},{"id":"p20s12","text":"is shared by every computer: each has its own signing key and claims its room on first connect, afte"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"r which only that key gets in, so someone who saw a pairing code cannot knock the computer off; a ro"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"om takes at most 8 phones, and phones and addresses are rate-limited. The web version loads only fro"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"m the relay's own address, and its content security policy lets it talk only to that relay and run o"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"nly its own scripts."}],"truncated":true}
